spec.hypothesis: SDGD-zero (embedding-based confusability-aware schema decomposition via graph coloring) improves F1 over single-pass and random-batching baselines on Few-NERD 66 types
spec.design: 4 modes: sdgd_zero (adaptive threshold k=1.0), single_pass (66 types at once), per_type (66 separate calls), random_batch (same k as SDGD). 1000 test samples. Prompt v2.
spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/schema-dag-extraction && python3 src/run_sdgd_experiment.py --mode sdgd_zero ... --mode single_pass ... --mode random_batch ... --mode per_type (sequential)
